segments.say: Loopback Transformer: towards a unified view of residual looped transformers.
segments.display: Loopback Transformer: towards a unified view of residual looped Transformers.

segments.say: Looped transformers reduce parameters by reusing shared blocks, but sharing alone does not decide how repeated computation is reused.
segments.display: Looped Transformers reduce parameters by reusing shared blocks, but sharing alone does not decide how repeated computation is reused.

segments.say: Addition lets the total update weight grow with depth, and a joint softmax makes the input compete with the updates.
segments.display: Addition lets the total update weight grow with depth, and a joint softmax makes the input compete with the updates.

segments.say: Loopback stores each block's update, keeps the input on its own path, and lets decay set the total weight while attention allocates it.
segments.display: Loopback stores each block's update, keeps the input on its own path, and lets decay set the total weight while attention allocates it.

segments.say: From one hundred ninety-one million to three billion parameters, Loopback reaches lower loss and a higher thirteen-task average than the standard transformer, with forty to seventy-five percent of its parameters.
segments.display: From 191M to 3B parameters, Loopback reaches lower loss and a higher thirteen-task average than the standard Transformer, with 40–75% of its parameters.

segments.say: Against the standard transformer and seven looped residual designs, Loopback has the lowest loss and the highest thirteen-task average at all three scales tested.
segments.display: Against the standard Transformer and seven looped residual designs, Loopback has the lowest loss and the highest thirteen-task average at all three scales tested.

segments.say: At larger scale, it also predicts math and code solutions better, and at three billion, word-problem accuracy rises from two point six to six point four percent.
segments.display: At larger scale, it also predicts math and code solutions better, and at 3B, word-problem accuracy rises from 2.6% to 6.4%.

segments.say: Run more loops at inference than in training, and Loopback degrades far less than plain addition.
segments.display: Run more loops at inference than in training, and Loopback degrades far less than plain addition.

segments.say: Both controls matter: without attention the loss rises, without decay it rises much more, and the gains hold across initializations.
segments.display: Both controls matter: without attention the loss rises, without decay it rises much more, and the gains hold across initializations.

segments.say: At a fixed parameter budget, deeper and narrower standard transformers lose ground, while Loopback's margin grows with depth.
segments.display: At a fixed parameter budget, deeper and narrower standard Transformers lose ground, while Loopback's margin grows with depth.

segments.say: The read adds under a tenth of a percent in flops; at three billion, training runs within six percent of the standard transformer's speed.
segments.display: The read adds under 0.1% in FLOPs; at 3B, training runs within 6% of the standard Transformer's speed.

segments.say: Loopback stores updates, keeps the input on its own path, and lets decay and attention control their weight: lower loss with fewer parameters.
segments.display: Loopback stores updates, keeps the input on its own path, and lets decay and attention control their weight: lower loss with fewer parameters.
